opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics from any country, on any continent, who are at risk in their home country or have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality. Covers academics needing postgraduate qualifications (e.g. a PhD) or postdoctoral placements, from all disciplines.
opportunities.summary: A rescue mission for academics in immediate danger of imprisonment, injury or death, helping them find temporary refuge (typically 2- or 3-year postdoctoral or PhD placements) at universities and research institutions in the UK and elsewhere, including visa support and practical arrangements for the Fellow and accompanying family members. Applications are considered on a rolling basis.
